# Configuration reference

Every setting can be given as an environment variable or as a key in
`mnemos.yaml`. An environment variable always wins over the file. Generated from
`internal/config/config.go` (`go run ./tools/configdoc`); a test fails when this
file, the code, or any `MNEMOS_*` name the code reads disagree.

| Variable | `mnemos.yaml` key | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `MNEMOS_DB_URL` | `db.url` | The brain's storage DSN: sqlite://, postgres://, mysql://, libsql:// or memory://. Unset, the local brain file is used. |
| `MNEMOS_DB_MAX_CONNS` | `db.max_conns` | Caps open connections to a networked database (Postgres, MySQL). Default 25. |
| `MNEMOS_DB_MAX_IDLE_CONNS` | `db.max_idle_conns` | Caps idle pooled connections (Postgres, MySQL). Default 5. |
| `MNEMOS_DB_CONN_MAX_LIFETIME` | `db.conn_max_lifetime` | Recycles a pooled connection after this Go duration (Postgres, MySQL). Default 30m. |
| `MNEMOS_PG_SHARED_POOL` | `db.shared_pool` | Makes a multi-tenant Postgres server check each request's connection out of one shared pool, instead of caching a connection per tenant for the life of the process. |
| `MNEMOS_LLM_PROVIDER` | `llm.provider` | Selects the LLM for extraction and relation detection: anthropic, openai, gemini, ollama or openai-compat. Unset, extraction is rule-based. |
| `MNEMOS_LLM_API_KEY` | `llm.api_key` | Authenticates to the LLM provider. Secret. |
| `MNEMOS_LLM_MODEL` | `llm.model` | Overrides the provider's default model. |
| `MNEMOS_LLM_BASE_URL` | `llm.base_url` | Overrides the provider's endpoint; required for openai-compat. |
| `MNEMOS_LLM_TIMEOUT` | `llm.timeout` | Bounds one LLM request, as a Go duration. Default 120s. |
| `MNEMOS_LLM_CACHE_MAX_BYTES` | `llm.cache_max_bytes` | Caps the on-disk LLM response cache. Default 1 GiB; 0 disables the size sweep (unbounded cache). |
| `MNEMOS_EXTRACT_MODEL` | `llm.extract_model` | Overrides llm.model for the extraction stage only, so a strong model can extract while a cheaper one does the rest. |
| `MNEMOS_EXTRACT_BATCH_CHARS` | `llm.extract_batch_chars` | Bounds one extraction request. A whole transcript in a single prompt overran the per-request timeout on local models, so extraction silently fell back to rule-based; batching keeps each request completable. Raise it for fast/large-context providers. Default 24000 characters. |
| `MNEMOS_EMBED_PROVIDER` | `embed.provider` | Selects the embedding model behind semantic recall: openai, gemini, ollama or openai-compat. Unset, it falls back to the LLM provider (Anthropic has no embedding API) or a local Ollama. |
| `MNEMOS_EMBED_API_KEY` | `embed.api_key` | Authenticates to the embedding provider; falls back to the LLM API key. Secret. |
| `MNEMOS_EMBED_MODEL` | `embed.model` | Overrides the provider's default embedding model. |
| `MNEMOS_EMBED_BASE_URL` | `embed.base_url` | Overrides the embedding endpoint. |
| `MNEMOS_EMBED_TIMEOUT` | `embed.timeout` | Bounds one embedding request, as a Go duration. Default 60s. |
| `MNEMOS_EMBED_BATCH` | `embed.batch` | Caps the texts in one embedding request during `reembed`. Default 64; lower it for self-hosted providers with small batch limits. |
| `MNEMOS_SERVE_PORT` | `serve.port` | The REST listener of `mnemos serve`. Default 7777. |
| `MNEMOS_TLS_CERT_FILE` | `serve.tls_cert_file` | Serves HTTPS with this certificate, with serve.tls_key_file. |
| `MNEMOS_TLS_KEY_FILE` | `serve.tls_key_file` | The private key for serve.tls_cert_file. |
| `MNEMOS_MTLS_CLIENT_CA_FILE` | `serve.mtls_client_ca_file` | Requires client certificates signed by this CA. |
| `MNEMOS_PUBLIC_READS` | `serve.public_reads` | Mirrors `serve --public-reads`: anonymous GET reads. It LOOSENS authentication, so it lives in reviewable config, not only in whichever flags a process started with. Off by default; not for hosted deployments. |
| `MNEMOS_METRICS_PUBLIC` | `serve.metrics_public` | Mirrors `serve --metrics-public`: anonymous /internal/metrics. Off by default. |
| `MNEMOS_TRUST_PROXY` | `serve.trust_proxy` | Mirrors `serve --trust-proxy`: take the client IP used for rate limiting from X-Forwarded-For. Set it only behind a proxy that overwrites the header; off by default. |
| `MNEMOS_CONSOLIDATE_INTERVAL` | `serve.consolidate_interval` | The hosted brain's sleep cadence: how often a running server consolidates (dedupe, trust refresh, credit, the skill loop, session-noise clearing). Defaults to the same ~daily gap the local brain sleeps on; 0 disables the cycle — set that on every replica but one, since the cycle is per process. |
| `MNEMOS_URL` | `server.url` | The hosted brain the hooks and client call instead of a local store. |
| `MNEMOS_TOKEN` | `server.token` | The bearer token sent to server.url. Secret. |
| `MNEMOS_JWT_SECRET` | `auth.jwt_secret` | Signs and verifies tokens: hex, at least 32 bytes. Unset, a per-install secret is created in auth.dir. Secret. |
| `MNEMOS_JWT_PREV_SECRET` | `auth.jwt_prev_secret` | Still verifies tokens signed before a secret rotation. Secret. |
| `MNEMOS_AUTH_DIR` | `auth.dir` | Holds the generated JWT secret. Default: .mnemos in the project root, else the home directory. |
| `MNEMOS_USER_ID` | `auth.user_id` | Stamps every write's actor. Unset, writes are attributed to the system user. |
| `MNEMOS_REGISTRY_URL` | `registry.url` | The federation registry `push` and `pull` talk to. |
| `MNEMOS_REGISTRY_TOKEN` | `registry.token` | Authenticates to the registry. Secret. |
| `MNEMOS_FEDERATION_ENABLED` | `federation.enabled` | Serves GET /v1/federation/export (anonymized playbooks). Off by default. |
| `MNEMOS_TELEMETRY_OPTIN` | `telemetry.optin` | Enables anonymized usage counts. Off by default; nothing is sent unless telemetry.endpoint is also set. |
| `MNEMOS_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT` | `telemetry.endpoint` | Receives the opted-in usage counts. |
| `MNEMOS_AXI_MAX_DURATION` | `kernel.max_duration` | Bounds one governed write session, as a Go duration. Default 5m. |
| `MNEMOS_AXI_MAX_INVOCATIONS` | `kernel.max_invocations` | Bounds capability calls per session. Default 1000. |
| `MNEMOS_AXI_MAX_TOKENS` | `kernel.max_tokens` | Bounds LLM tokens per session. Default unlimited. |
| `MNEMOS_AXI_EVIDENCE_LOG` | `kernel.evidence_log` | Appends every governed write's evidence as JSONL to this file. Symlinks are refused. |
| `MNEMOS_FEEDBACK_CONTEST_THRESHOLD` | `feedback.contest_threshold` | The negative-feedback count at which a belief becomes contested. Default 3. |
| `MNEMOS_FEEDBACK_DECAY` | `feedback.decay` | Multiplies confidence on each negative feedback. Default 0.9. |
| `MNEMOS_JOB_TIMEOUT` | `job.timeout` | Bounds one CLI job attempt, as a Go duration. Default 10m. Whole-brain maintenance (`relate --prune-supports`) defaults to 4h unless this is set. |
| `MNEMOS_SPREADING_ACTIVATION` | `query.spreading_activation` | Primes strongly-associated beliefs (ADR 0013 §2). Read-only ranking. Off unless set to true: it lowered recall quality on LoCoMo (ADR 0030). |
| `MNEMOS_SALIENCE` | `query.salience` | Blends a bounded stakes term into ranking (ADR 0013 §4). Read-only ranking. |
| `MNEMOS_HEBBIAN` | `query.hebbian` | Strengthens edges among co-retrieved beliefs (ADR 0015 §4). WRITES. |
| `MNEMOS_RECONSOLIDATE` | `query.reconsolidate` | Re-marks recalled beliefs verified-now (ADR 0015 §5). WRITES. |
| `MNEMOS_INHIBIT` | `query.inhibit` | Suppresses retrievability of a beaten contradiction loser (ADR 0016), never its trust. WRITES. |
| `MNEMOS_CAPTURE_STRATEGY` | `capture.strategy` | Chooses when the capture hook ingests: auto, incremental, end or off. auto picks incremental for local inference and end for hosted providers; mnemos.example.yaml has the per-provider guidance. |
| `MNEMOS_CAPTURE_TIMEOUT` | `capture.timeout` | Bounds one session's capture pipeline, as a Go duration. Default 4m. |
| `MNEMOS_FLOATBACK_ON_CAPTURE` | `floatback.on_capture` | Also floats repo learnings to the personal brain at session end. Off by default. |
| `MNEMOS_PLASTICITY_SENSITIVITY` | `plasticity.sensitivity` | Scales surprise-driven learning-rate gain. Default 1.0; 0 disables neuromodulation only. |
| `MNEMOS_EPISODIC_EVENTS` | `pipeline.episodic_events` | Types operational events (deploys, releases, merges, incidents) at ingest. Off by default. |
| `MNEMOS_METRICS_SAMPLE_INTERVAL` | `metrics.sample_interval` | The product-metrics sampler cadence, as a Go duration. Default 60s; 0 disables it. |
| `MNEMOS_LOG_LEVEL` | `log.level` | Sets log verbosity: trace, debug, info, warn or error. Default info. |
| `MNEMOS_PRECEDENCE` | `precedence` | Selects the read-time federation policy (ADR 0011 Phase C): tenant-wins (default), global-wins, or surface-dissonance. It decides which tier wins — or whether the conflict is surfaced — when a federated read turns up the same topic from both the global and the tenant/repo brain. |

## Not configuration

Read from the environment but deliberately not part of `mnemos.yaml`: process
plumbing, diagnostics and test hooks.

| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `MNEMOS_CONFIG` | Path to the mnemos.yaml to load, overriding discovery. The --config flag wins over it. It names the file, so it cannot be set in the file. |
| `MNEMOS_RELATE_TRACE` | Diagnostics: when true, every incremental relate pass writes one line to stderr (candidates, pairs evaluated, edges kept, tokens the candidate budget skipped). |
